verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item describes scoped or least-privilege API key/credential issuance (e.g., restricting a key to specific models, methods, or quotas) for agent use; community threads instead describe the opposite pain (a leaked, unrestricted API key racking up a $6,909 bill, and no easy way to even set a hard billing cap), suggesting fine-grained credential scoping is not a documented capability.
